notes: The KINA unit is printed inside 'Required Courses (17 units)'; it is recorded as its own choose_units block with no listed courses (any KINA course; ATHL courses excluded). The 17-unit stated total of Required Courses includes this 1 unit (16 units of named courses + 1 KINA unit).
KINE 219 is printed 'KINE 219' in the catalog and 'KINE219' (no space) in the closed list; treated as the same course, not a catalog addition.
KINE 218 is marked '( Historical )' in the catalog, printed as an OR alternative to KINE 224.
KINE 252 is suggested ('may be interested in taking') with no units printed; recorded as recommended and a catalog addition.
The last learning outcome is cut off in the source text ('flexibili'); copied as printed, not completed.
The Program Summary calls the program 'Exercise Science - Fitness Specialist Certificate', which differs from the title 'Fitness Professional'.

The summary names certifications (GEL, ACE Group Fitness Instructor, ACSM CPT, NASM Personal Trainer) and 'commercial and corporate fitness industries' but no explicit career titles; careers left empty.
